title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Burglary Deductible Base on Re-Settlement After Recovery
content:
When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim is re-settled after stolen property is recovered, the re-settlement deductible is taken from the re-settlement deductible base.

| Peril on the claim as filed | Covered unit class (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement) | Re-settlement deductible base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| burglary | drive-up access | 10 percent of the missing-property total, never less than the level's deductible |
| burglary | no drive-up access | 5 percent of the missing-property total, never less than the level's deductible |
| any other peril | any | the level's deductible |

In words: the re-settlement deductible base is the level's deductible, except that for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has drive-up access it is 10 percent of the missing-property total, and for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has no drive-up access it is 5 percent of the missing-property total, in both burglary situations never less than the level's deductible.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Burglary, drive-up class, missing-property total 3,200.00, level deductible 250.00: 10 percent is 320.00, so the base is 320.00. Burglary, interior class, same total: 5 percent is 160.00, so the base is 250.00.
